key_idea: Follow each path with your finger, one arrow is one square.
steps: The rabbit starts in the bottom left square. The bird is in the top right square.
Path D: go up 2 squares, then right 2 squares. These squares are all white.
Then go up 1 and right 1. That is the bird's square.
Path D never steps on a blue square.

choice_feedback.A: After going up 2 and right 1, the next step up lands on a blue square.
choice_feedback.B: This path stays white, but it ends one row below the bird.
choice_feedback.C: Going right 3 along the second row lands on the blue square at the end.
choice_feedback.E: Going up 4 times takes the rabbit off the top of the grid.
